whole_requirement_axes_unchanged.target: A reservation is not residency, and one predicate answers both the gate and the report. Tier tokens are taken at CLAIM and only bound occupancy. A movement node is RESIDENT only when it still holds its tier tokens AND a current map fragment for this consumer/tier/manifest vouches for the bytes (plan stage root on the stage leg; announced ram root under the announced epoch on the ram leg) AND it is not claimed/ AND a complete record_move receipt covers the plan-sealed span AND that receipt's entries_declared == entries_staged equals the current fragment's entry count. No payload read, no hashing, no whole-manifest stat. Unreadable or malformed evidence is UNKNOWN and is never reported as not-staged; the census reports the booking as reserved beside staged. UNKNOWN survives aggregation: cursor_gap counts unstaged_phases/unstaged_bytes only for a false leg, carries unknown_phases/unknown_bytes beside them additively against remaining_phases, and a chunked leg is true only when every chunk is, false as soon as one chunk is known missing, unknown otherwise. Testing a three-state answer with 'is not True' is banned. prismabuild_residency_unstaged_* therefore counts known backlog only.
